newsitem.title: FRANCE: Parfinance might sell Paribas,Axa-UAP stakes-paper.
newsitem.headline: Parfinance might sell Paribas,Axa-UAP stakes-paper.

text.p: Investment firm Parfinance could sell a stake in Paribas which represents 13 percent of its net assets, and a stake in UAP representing eight percent of its net assets before UAP's merger with AXA, daily Les Echos said on Friday.

Parfinance vice-chairman Aimery Langlois-Meurinne limited himself to telling shareholders on Thursday that his group's stakes in the two groups might "evolve provided this was agreed with the management of the two companies, and the bourse share price allowed for it".
The newspaper mentioned that Parfinance has already sold part of its Paribas stake at the end of 1996 and said that some analysts believed further changes were likely.
